architectureNotes.sharedBase: All portals extend BasePortalConnector; only Housing has portal-specific SERP/extract.
architectureNotes.browserLifecycle: BrowserFactory.launchPersistent + BrowserPool warm page per workspace::portal; SessionLoader cookies+storage.
architectureNotes.ocrFallback: NOT IMPLEMENTED — connectors/extraction-engine.ts is interface stub only; no OCR in tree.
architectureNotes.pagination: NOT IMPLEMENTED — single results page harvest only.
architectureNotes.resourceBlocking: Automation contexts abort image/font/media + trackers — can break bot-managed SPAs.
architectureNotes.headlessDefault: RESEARCH_BROWSER_HEADLESS !== true → headed (Akamai note for Housing).
